name: TX-19
label: Safe R

key_factors: Open seat removes incumbent risk but no Democratic opening
model.rationale: This West Texas seat carries a heavy Republican lean, and the GOP nominee has outraised the Democrat by roughly 70-to-1 with substantial outside support, while markets price the race at 99% Republican. With no polls or expert ratings suggesting any Democratic opening, the forecast stays firmly in Safe R territory.
model.watch: A late surge of Democratic outside spending or a scandal involving the Republican nominee would be the only realistic path to narrowing this race.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.
Open seat: Jodey Arrington (R) is not on the ballot.

overview:
Republicans are heavily favored to hold this open West Texas congressional seat. The district carries a strong Republican partisan lean, and the GOP nominee has built an overwhelming financial advantage, raising over $2.1 million with more than $1.3 million in outside support, while the Democratic nominee has raised about $31,000. Prediction markets price the Republican at roughly 99%.

With no public polls or expert ratings indicating a competitive race, the forecast rests on fundamentals and money, both of which point decisively to the Republican. The open seat removes any incumbency factor, but there is no evidence of a Democratic opening here.
